title: SEKTION wall cabinet with 2 doors
description: SEKTION wall cabinet with 2 doors, white/Vedhamn oak, 36x15x30" SEKTION kitchen system gives you endless possibilities to design your dream kitchen. Paired with robust VEDHAMN fronts in oak you get a natural, warm look that makes you feel right at home. Sturdy frame construction, ¾" thick.
features: To be finished with legs and plinth, sold separately.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
The hinge is adjustable in height, depth and width.
To be completed with SEKTION suspension rail for mounting the cabinet to the wall.
Requires a knob or a handle
